question: What is the total amount of liabilities owed by the U.S. Treasury to the United Kingdom in CY1986 in billions of dollars rounded to the nearest hundredths place?
raw_response:
I read Table CM-I-3, “Total Liabilities by Country,” which reports positions in millions of dollars. The United Kingdom value for calendar year 1986 is 90,833 million dollars, i.e. 90.833 billion dollars, rounded to 90.83.

<FINAL_ANSWER>90.83</FINAL_ANSWER>
